details.name: Counting the Occurrences of One String in Another (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives a string and returns the number of times that the string "hi" appears anywhere in the given string, ignoring the case.

details.name: Counting the Occurrences of One String in Another (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that has a function that receives a string and returns the number of times that the string "hi?t" appears anywhere in the given string where '?' could be any letter. For example, "hint" and "hilt" would count as a match.\nAll string comparisons should be case-insensitive.
